checks.name: The caregiver turns child mode on behind the PIN; the child then sees only nine big pictures
A tap says the word at once, shows it large, and is logged as a device-only child message
A quick accidental second tap on the same picture is ignored; other pictures respond at once
The caregiver switches to a ready-made board and edits it; the child board follows
The game asks for pictures, highlights the answer after two misses, and ends with five stars
Progress appears for the caregiver: stars, first-try finds and words to practise
On a phone in portrait the board uses three columns and keeps every picture over 2 cm
Turning child mode off brings back the full board with its grid and Vuga
Child mode raised no uncaught page errors
